jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Technical Business Analyst to support a large-scale commercial CRM transformation within a global enterprise environment. This role will serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams, supporting the transition to Microsoft Dynamics 365 and helping translate business processes and requirements into scalable technology solutions.  Location:LATAM 100% Remote. Working hours are based on the US Central Time Zone. Minimum 6-hour overlap  About the Company:   Abstra  is a fast-growing, Nearshore Tech Talent services company, providing top Latin American tech talent to U.S. companies and beyond. Founded by U.S.-bred engineers with over 15 years of experience,  Abstra  specializes in sourcing skilled professionals across a wide range of technologies to meet our clients’ needs, driving innovation and efficiency.  Key Responsibilities  Business & Requirements Analysis  
 Partner with business, technology, and functional stakeholders to understand processes, pain points, objectives, and technology needs. 
 Lead requirements discovery through interviews, workshops, process reviews, and analysis of existing systems and documentation. 
 Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, and non-functional requirements. 
 Translate business needs into requirements, process flows, use cases, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria. 
 Identify and document business rules, exceptions, dependencies, assumptions, and gaps. 
 Facilitate requirements walkthroughs, stakeholder alignment, and validation. 
 Maintain requirements traceability throughout design, development, testing, and deployment. 
  Microsoft Dynamics 365 & Solution Analysis  
 Support the design and implementation of business processes and capabilities within Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM. 
 Partner with functional consultants, architects, developers, and integration teams to translate business requirements into solution designs. 
 Assess requirements against standard Dynamics 365 capabilities and identify needs for configuration, customization, integration, or process changes. 
 Support CRM capabilities including case management, customer service workflows, queues and routing, activities, customer/account information, and agent workflows. 
  SDLC & Delivery Support  
 Support functional analysis throughout the full SDLC, from discovery and design through development, testing, deployment, and stabilization. 
 Partner with product owners and delivery teams to refine and prioritize the backlog and participate in Agile ceremonies. 
 Clarify requirements during implementation and review delivered functionality against requirements and acceptance criteria. 
 Support functional and integration testing, defect triage, UAT scenarios/test cases, and business acceptance. 
 Support deployment readiness, release validation, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization. 
 Assess impacts of new functionality, configuration changes, integrations, and system migrations. 
  Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration  
 Serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into actionable technical requirements. 
 Facilitate workshops with stakeholders across functions, regions, and organizational levels. 
 Identify and communicate gaps, risks, dependencies, and decisions requiring escalation. 
 Coordinate across workstreams and technology teams to ensure end-to-end requirements and dependencies are understood. 
 Navigate ambiguity and drive issues toward clear decisions and actionable next steps. 
 Maintain project documentation such as requirements, process flows, business rules, data mappings, decision logs, and traceability artifacts. 
  Required Qualifications  
 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or similar role supporting enterprise technology initiatives. 
 Hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM experience in business analysis, functional analysis, or implementation. 
 Strong experience eliciting, analyzing, documenting, and validating business and functional requirements. 
 Experience supporting the full SDLC, including design, development, testing, deployment, and stabilization. 
 Ability to translate requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional specifications, and related delivery artifacts. 
 Ability to understand and document system integrations, data flows, mappings, dependencies, and business rules. 
 Experience with CRM implementations, migrations, transformations, or major platform enhancements. 
 Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum practices and tools. 
 Experience working in large, complex, matrixed organizations with globally distributed teams. 
 Strong stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with technical and non-technical audiences.

About the Role  We are looking for a  Customer Service Representative  to support customer accounts throughout the order fulfillment process. In this role, you will be responsible for processing purchase orders, coordinating with internal teams, monitoring order and shipping status, and ensuring customers receive timely and accurate updates.  The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive in communication, and comfortable coordinating across multiple teams to ensure customer requirements and delivery commitments are met.  Key Responsibilities  Purchase Order Management  
  Review purchase orders, including pricing, raw material availability, and production schedules.  
  Coordinate with the  RFQ team  when a quotation is required.  
  Enter and upload purchase orders into the system, ensuring all customer requirements, quantities, and due dates are accurately recorded.  
  Coordinate same-day with the  Production Scheduler  and  Materials Manager  to ensure orders are created and lead times are confirmed.  
  Send order acknowledgments to customers via email or customer portals.  
  Customer Communication & Support  
  Respond to customer requests, questions, and complaints on the same business day.  
  Investigate customer inquiries by coordinating with relevant internal teams and gathering the required information.  
  Clearly communicate timelines and provide updates when additional information or more time is needed to resolve a customer request.  
  Maintain professional, proactive, and timely communication with customers throughout the order process.  
  Customer Release & Schedule Management  
  Review, modify, and update customer  blanket release schedules  as needed.  
  Process customer releases received through  EDI, customer portals, and email .  
  Ensure customer schedules and requirements are accurately reflected in internal systems.  
  Order & Delivery Monitoring  
  Review current and two-week future shipping lines to monitor  on-time delivery performance .  
  Identify potential delays or risks to customer delivery dates.  
  Proactively communicate delays to customers and coordinate internally to determine realistic recovery timelines.  
  Follow up on recovery plans to ensure customer commitments are met.  
  Parts & Production Follow-Up  
  Track parts through  OSS  and monitor their progress to ensure timely processing.  
  Coordinate with OSS and relevant internal teams to identify potential issues and prevent delays.  
  Provide customers with accurate status updates when required.  
  Working conditions:  
  Work schedule:  Monday - Friday 7 am-4 pm CST   
  Competitive Salary in USD  
  Remote mode of work  
  10+ business days of paid time off  
  Team building and corporate events  
  Equipment provided  
  A supportive team  
  Requirements  Requirements  
  Previous experience in  Customer Service, Order Management, Logistics, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or a related field .  
  Experience working with  Purchase Orders, customer schedules, and order fulfillment processes .  
  Strong written and verbal communication skills.  
  Ability to manage multiple customer requests and priorities simultaneously.  
  Strong attention to detail and accuracy.  
  Proactive approach to problem-solving and follow-up.  
  Experience working with  EDI, customer portals, and/or ERP systems  is a plus.  
  Ability to communicate effectively with both customers and internal departments.  
  Good organizational and time-management skills.  
  What We’re Looking For  
   Customer-focused:  You prioritize customer needs and ensure timely, clear communication.  
   Detail-oriented:  You carefully review orders, schedules, pricing, quantities, and delivery dates.  
   Proactive:  You identify potential issues before they impact customers and take action to resolve them.  
   Collaborative:  You work effectively with production, materials, scheduling, RFQ, and OSS teams.
